label: A two-world, one-individual S5 model satisfies Scott's A1a, A1b, A2, A3 and A4…, by Direct-proof
meaning: Construct a two-world S5 frame with a single individual and positivity evaluated at one designated world. Verify each of A1a–A4 and the possibility corollary, then exhibit a world-relative essence whose necessary exemplification fails. Thus A5 and T3 fail in an actual finite model; there is no premise that merely asserts the desired independence.
